Capability initializes smellyTime/immunityTime=-1; each remaining getter computes max(0,(int)(deadline-currentWorldTotalTime)) if deadline>=0. isSmellingBad is remaining smell>0 AND remaining immunity<=0. setSmellingBad writes now+duration regardless immunity; setImmune writes now+duration without erasing smell. setNotSmellingBad only writes smell=-1. Setters dirty trackers; mere passage of either deadline does not clear fields or dirty.

Native BlockStagnantWater.onEntityCollision server-player branch reads effective !isSmellingBad then requests max(raw remaining smell,24000). Thus ordinarily visible smell is not refreshed; while immune, effective smell is false, so water repeatedly renews a latent absolute exposure deadline. Immunity does not reject acquisition. Independent decay potion request and decay acceleration in same collision are outside smell protection; their native success not proven.

critical_boundaries: Whole proposed difference is immunity masking effective state while actual environment can reacquire stored exposure, followed by deadline unmasking and different real AI eligibility consumers. Generic timed immunity, another debuff name or particle factory alone would0.

Manual cleansing is not preventive: clean players and players with hidden smell during immunity receive no600 extension and no consumption, although use return and client bubbles remain success-like. Do not report visual bubbles as server acceptance.

Under ordinary world-time arithmetic, water while visibly smelly does not refresh, water while immune refreshes latent smell to at least24000. At immunity expiry the still-positive raw smell becomes effective. No remove/re-add hook fires; this is not a hidden PotionEffect rollover.

Smelly-selector continuation omits parent distance/sight/team/creative/target-class checks; no native parent/scheduler source was located in the fixed cache (similarly named Lycanites class is not the Minecraft parent). We do not substitute versions or infer engine reset behavior. Explicit returnfalse is proven, immediate actual target clear is not.

Wight custom predicate is only initial suitability; existing pursuit and independent revenge/attack tasks can persist. Immunity is not all-mob target denial, total stealth, damage protection, decay immunity or guaranteed disengagement.

Deadline subtraction casts long to int before clamp, raw saved longs unvalidated. Extreme/future/old times or clock shifts can produce overflow/incorrect remaining calculations. No global-world-clock synchronization or dimension rebase claim.

Setters lack universal side guard; known water/manual callers are server-guarded, client tick only generates flies. Packet mirrors deadlines, not an authoritative target-denial receipt, and local clock agreement was not tested.

TrackingTime20 is readiness threshold checked before increment, not unconditional exact20tick periodic snapshot. With lastUpdate0 and dirty, ordinary update becomes ready on21st call. Deadline expiry alone does not dirty, and retained snapshot can change effective state locally.

Invalid external tracker may be removed then still updated this iteration, as coordinator corrected in018. No total no-late-packet guarantee. Initial/missing-target packet handling, nondeath Clone and current-dimension checks are support0.

Fly own class lacks player/capability/target identity. It wanders near its initial coordinates and is not tethered to current player, not per-monster denial feedback. Existing flies need not disappear on cure. Parent expiry and textures/audio/visual acceptance unverified.

Only native registration bindings, actual methods and selected helper chains cited. Not full Wight/Lurker entities, native vanilla AI parent, decay system, advancement implementation or Censer tile. No game/nativeJava/network/build/asset actions.

Migration captured-fish freshness owner remains whole and receives no new credit; that producer is not used as the new core chain. Censer body and all API/serialization/packet/registry/factory wrappers support0.
